text.short: Boise, the Basque Block, December 2005. A dining room with a hotel over it, two patios, and a bar that runs to midnight.
text.today: Kitchen to 10, bar to midnight, six days. Booking through Resy. Happy hour Tuesday to Saturday, 4 to 6.
text.history: Jose Mari Artiach came from the Basque Country as a sheepherder and opened it in December 2005.
text.note: Leku ona is good place in Euskara — the same two words as Toki Ona in Elko, said another way.

seating.note: Table dining, casual and formal, inside and on two patios. Nothing on the site puts strangers together.

picon.note: A drinks menu and a happy hour; the site names neither Picon nor Kalimotxo.

kin.how: one of the five doors on it
the same two Euskara words, 400 miles south
came as a sheepherder and opened this room
the state this room sits in
